release_notes:
**Release Tag:** `1.0.4`  
**Target App:** Google Pixel Camera `11.1.040.982810059.19` (APKM -> https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/camera/pixel-camera-11-1-040-982810059-19-release/)  
**Supported Devices:** Google Pixel 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 series (Tensor G1 – G5)

---

## What's New in v1.0.4

### 1. All 13 Camera Looks Unlocked (3 New Looks Added)
In addition to the 10 original signature Looks, all **3 brand-new Pixel Camera 11.1 Looks** are now fully enabled and integrated directly into the carousel UI:
* **Flat** (`qvd` / *Pesto*): Low-contrast, high dynamic range flat color profile optimized for post-shot color grading.
* **Buffalo** (`qvg` / *Unflat*): Warm, punchy earth tones with balanced contrast and expanded dynamic latitude.
* **Dijon** (`qvi` / *Yellow-Green Faded*): Nostalgic retro analog look with olive-tinted highlights and muted shadows.
* *Total available Looks:* **13** (Original, Natural, Vanilla, Editorial, Shadows, Velvet, Classic, Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Flat, Buffalo, Dijon).

---

### 2. Viewfinder Dual Sliders & Universal Bidirectional Sync
* **Viewfinder Tap-to-Focus Sliders Restored:** Resolved the issue where the dual sliders were missing from the viewfinder. Sliders now reliably appear on tap-to-focus across all modes.
* **Full Dynamic Exposure Range:** Restored full range on both sliders:
  * **Brightness:** -4.0 to +4.0 stops.
  * **Shadow:** Linearized HDR+ shadow boost up to 15.3x.
* **Bidirectional Synchronization:** Viewfinder on-screen knobs and bottom sheet drawers now share the exact same underlying HAL observables—scrubbing either slider updates the other instantly in real time.
* **Camera2 HAL Preview Integration:** Decoupled `DualEvCtrl` from twilight flags (`ptm.g = false`), allowing real-time tone mapping previews directly in the viewfinder.

---

### 3. Pixel 10 & Pro 12MP Photo Saving Fix
* Fixed an issue on Pixel 10 / Tensor G5 hardware where 12MP captures failed to save or froze during post-processing.
* Disabled incompatible Tensor G5-exclusive pipelines (`camera.ceftazidime = 0` Flare Removal and `camera.use_eclipse = 0` Eclipse AE).
* Injected fallbacks for binned RAW stream dimensions (`tele_binned_raw_width` = 2016, `tele_binned_raw_height` = 1512, `binned_row_start` = 0) to ensure zero capture drops.

---

### 4. Complete Feature Matrix
* **Permanent Portrait Mode Fix:** Pure-TFLite monocular depth routing (`midasnet`, `portrait_matting_mask`) fixing front camera blur and rear camera bokeh drops.
* **Pro Manual Controls:** Unlocks Manual Focus, Shutter Speed, ISO, and Focus Peaking on all supported models.
* **10x Quick Zoom:** Discrete 10x viewfinder zoom toggle in Photo mode.
* **Creator Suite:** Teleprompter HUD (`biotite`), Live Audio VU Meter (`mica`), and Social Framing Guides (`slate`).
* **Non-Root App Clone:** Installable side-by-side with stock Pixel Camera (`com.google.android.GoogleCamera.morphe`).

---

##  How to Install via Morphe Manager

1. Download and install the latest **Morphe Manager** on your device.
2. Download official **Pixel Camera 11.1** APK (`11.1.040.982810059.19`). 
3. Download **`morphe-patches-pixelcamera-1.0.4.mpp`** (or `patches-1.0.4.mpp`) from the Assets below.
4. In Morphe Manager:
   * Select the downloaded Pixel Camera APK.
   * Load the patch bundle (`.mpp`).
   * Select your preferred patches and tap **Patch**.
5. Install the generated APK and enjoy!

---
